name: Ban flower
summary: Young ban flower and leaves. The culture desk names a salad, a salad with galangal, a stir-fry with meat, and a salad with sesame, and puts the flower on the passes in March. Vietnam News adds April, and a white, red, and purple bloom on Vietnamnet. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Dien Bien Phu. The culture desk’s March note is the season line. Vietnam News says March and April. Both stay. The 2026 festival week moved, and a week outside those months is Check on arrival.
culture: Vietnam News quotes elder Bùi Thị Điệt: a young woman named Ban died looking for the man her parents had refused, and a white spring tree grew at that spot. The culture desk says the story is told at the fire and does not print it. Hoàng Thị Nọong, quoted by Vietnam News, names xôi ban, ban salad, fried ban flowers with bamboo shoots, and ban soup.
taste: Vietnam News quotes Nọong on the salad: chilli, peppers, dổi, mắc khén, and wild seeds. Writer Nguyễn Hoàng Hưng, quoted there, calls that salad aromatic. The culture desk does not print those seasonings.
howToEat: The culture desk’s plates are nộm rau ban, ban salad with galangal, stir-fried ban with meat, and ban salad with sesame. Eat them at a fire.

Vietnamnet names stir-fried ban with wild pork, salad with galangal, and sesame salad, and says March brings white, red, and purple ban. The culture desk’s stir-fry says meat and does not say wild pork. Both stay.
Xôi ban, fried ban flowers with bamboo shoots, and ban soup are names on Vietnam News. A method for those three is Check on arrival.
A price is Check on arrival.
where: The festival table and the passes, in March on the culture desk and in March and April on Vietnam News. Not a cafe. A week outside those months is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ban flower in Dien Bien Phu — salad and stir-fry
seoDescription: Young ban flower and leaves in March on the culture desk, March and April on Vietnam News. Salad, galangal, sesame, and stir-fry. A price is Check on arrival.
